about: Repositories the census finds, mostly on curated lists, that are not Zotero plugins: add-ons for other apps, standalone tools, parts or copies of Zotero itself, libraries and docs for plugin developers, translators, styles and scripts, lists or copies of other developers' plugins (including a cracked one), and empty repositories. They get no card. Each was checked by hand against the repository on GitHub. Keyed by GitHub owner/repo.
